title: Antifungal and Antibiofilm Activity of Cyclic Temporin L Peptide Analogues against Albicans and Non-Albicans Candida Species.

materials_exhausted.note: Opened packet manifest, locator index, primary XML/PDF/PDF text, OA NXML/PDF, the OA supplementary ZIP member PDF, supplementary indexes/tables, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows. Local supplement contains analytical/HPLC data only and does not change activity/toxicity row values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows against primary Table 1 MIC rows, Table 2 MIC/MFC rows, and article metadata. Unverifiable MBIC/MBEC exact values and target-strain conflicts are preserved as caution-bearing non-source-verified database rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered the missing Table 1 activity matrix and rebuilt Table 2 into source-located MIC/MFC rows with fungal target labels, raw μM units, assay-method context, and locators. Figure-only values were not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced framework locator notes with bounded source-reviewed mechanism context for antibiofilm phenotype, fungal-membrane leakage, zeta/aggregation assays, and Ames-test toxicity context without overclaiming a complete molecular mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original complete-message rework ticket is closed: Table 1/Table 2 activity rows are source-located, database conflicts carry explicit context, and no blocking or major rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet supplementary index is empty, but the OA package ZIP was opened during re-review; its supplementary PDF contains analytical/HPLC data and no additional activity/toxicity table values.
DBAASP rows for DBAASPS_18791 list Candida albicans ATCC 90029, while primary Tables 1-2 use C. albicans ATCC 90028.
Linked DBAASP MBIC/MBEC rows remain database_only_no_primary_source because local primary material has figure-level biofilm curves but no exact numeric table for those values.
Table 1 modified-residue sequence notation is retained as reported and not normalized into canonical unmodified one-letter sequences.
The methods section mentions C. parapsilosis DSM 4874, while Tables 1-2 and linked DBAASP rows use DSM 5784; activity rows follow the table-specific target labels.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the activity table gap, made all source conflicts explicit, preserved database-only antibiofilm rows without fabricating values, and accepts the paper with cautions after strict gates are rerun.
